# llms.txt — Fresh Ink docs section

This file orients an LLM agent to the documentation resources for Fresh Ink's booking platform.

## What this section covers

- REST API endpoint reference with request/response shapes and the envelope format
- Error codes and rate-limit behavior
- MCP tool reference (get_studio_info, list_open_times, hold_slot, get_booking_status)

## Key links

- [OpenAPI spec](https://freshink.art/api/public/openapi.json)
- [MCP server card](https://freshink.art/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json)
- [Authentication walkthrough](https://freshink.art/auth.md) (anonymous + optional API key)

## When to use this section

Use it when the agent needs endpoint-level detail beyond the overview in /llms.txt — parameter shapes, error codes, or the MCP tool schemas.
